marker: # unit_length and ref_repeats are read from the locus name in Table S2, which encodes the repeat
# unit length, the CO92 amplicon size and the CO92 repeat number as NAME_<unit>bp_<size>bp_<n>U.
# The label keeps that published identifier unchanged. The unit lengths agree with the motif
# lengths Table 1 gives for the same loci, which is an independent check of all 26.
# ref_size is the product these primers give in the CO92 assembly GCA_000009065.1 by in silico
# PCR. It equals the size encoded in the label at 21 of the 26 loci. At the five below the encoded
# size is not the product its own primers give, and the measured length instead equals the value
# that an independently bundled scheme records for the same locus with the same primer pair, so
# the measured one is used here and the published one is left in the label:
#   yp0718ms41  217 measured, 218 encoded; ms41 of yersinia_mlva25_lefleche_2001 is 217
#   yp4425ms38  233 measured, 251 encoded; ms38 of the same scheme is 233
#   M61         356 measured, 357 encoded; M61 of yersinia_klevytska_2001 is 356
#   M29         231 measured, 233 encoded; M29 of the same scheme is 231, one primer mismatches
#   M34         225 measured, 255 encoded; M34 of the same scheme is 225
# The repeat number pairs with the measured size in every one of the five, because the corroborating
# scheme records the same repeat count there, so no allele is shifted by the correction.
# No repeat unit sequences are published for these loci, so patterns is N/A throughout: alleles are
# called from amplicon length and the tandem count is not a cross-check.
# M58 and M34 are also known as ms04 and ms62 in the Pourcel nomenclature, which Table S2 appends
# to the locus name; the alias is left out of the label so that the encoded values parse.
